Believers staying home, other than the disabled, are not equal to those who strive with wealth and lives; Allah promised both the best but raised the strivers by degrees.
Those who stayed behind from Tabuk rejoiced, saying do not go out in the heat; they may never go out with the Prophet, nor may he pray over their dead.
No blame is on the weak, the ill, those with nothing to spend, or those who wept for want of mounts, but on the rich who asked to stay behind.
Madinah and nearby bedouins should not stay behind the Messenger, as every hardship in Allah's cause is recorded; yet not all should go, some staying to learn religion and warn.
Bedouins who stayed behind from Hudaybiyyah make excuses and seek booty; called to face a mighty people, they are rewarded if they obey; the blind, lame and ill are excused.
